51.description: The feature vector represents subword tokens and fragments commonly found in Hindi and Indian-language scripts as well as English text processing artifacts.

179.description: These tokens represent common Hindi vowel matras and punctuation marks used in text formatting.

77.description: These tokens represent inflectional suffixes and root morphemes characteristic of Hindi verb conjugation and grammatical gender/number agreement.

63.description: This vector activates for Hindi vowel matras, suffixes, and character fragments.

65.description: These tokens represent common character combinations and vowel-consonant ligatures from the Devanagari script used for writing Hindi and other Indian languages.

62.description: These tokens represent common Hindi word endings and suffixes, primarily functioning as noun-forming or verb-inflecting morphological components.

74.description: This vector is related to subword tokens and fragments in Devanagari script alongside miscellaneous numbers.

94.description: These tokens represent a collection of various Hindi characters, consonant clusters, and vowel signs in the Devanagari script.

172.description: This vector activates on characters, syllables, and words written in the Devanagari script.

144.description: This vector represents Devanagari script characters, conjuncts, and sub-syllabic text fragments commonly found in Hindi or Sanskrit tokenization.
